svg.text: To-Be: AI-first onboarding and periodic review, with human approval gates
Illustrative redesign for a CIB branch in Hong Kong. Built from public material; simulated, not real bank data.
Fixed: Generic checklist by email: the client can't tell what applies to them
Fixed: Packs arrive incomplete, so the client is chased in several rounds
Fixed: The same data is typed into several systems by hand
Fixed: Ownership is traced through registries country by country
Fixed: Most screening hits are false positives, each cleared by hand
Fixed: Defects surface at the end, sending the file back
Fixed: Each review restarts from scratch, even when nothing changed
First request: one tailored list, one upload
Asked again: at most one follow-up, every item at once, and none on a review with nothing missing
Accounts live: days sooner, with fewer asks
